serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: I see you are cleaning up after yourself. Good. Keep my property nice and clean. The last thing I want is for some dirty bum to lower its value.
You: …
Mission accomplished so I should go home already, but Mr. Landlord looks a little conflicted for some reason…
He just stands there with these trash bags for God knows how long…
You: Um, are you waiting for someone?
Landlord: No…
You: So. {{wi}}Are you going to throw these bags in or not?
Landlord: I’m still thinking, ok?! 
You: What’s there to think about?
Landlord: These are Halloween decorations, you buffoon.
You: And how was I supposed to know it? They are inside trash bags.
Landlord: Shut it!
Landlord: You see, my little girl loved Halloween. We would decorate our home every year, make a bunch of food with pumpkin and other stuff…
Landlord: But now she’s all grown up and doesn’t have time for these things…
Landlord: These decorations remind me of all these good memories and…{{wi}} I just can’t bring myself to throw them out…
You: Then don’t.
Landlord: Are you dumb?! Every time I look at them I get nostalgic and sad. I need to get rid of them!
Landlord: Also, what if one day my angel came home and wanted to use them? She would be so disappointed if they were gone!
You: I guess there is no way out of this situation.
He can stay here forever for all I care. Maybe frostbite would make him forget about my rent?
You: Ok then, good luck. I gotta go.
Landlord: Wait a minute!
You: W-what?
Landlord: Hmm… {{wi}}Maybe there is a way out of this situation after all…
Landlord: How about you take them? These decorations are pretty nice and expensive, you know? I’m sure they would look great in your room.
Landlord: And when my cute little daughter changes her mind, I would come back for them. How about that?
You: Um, I’m not really into decorating that much…
Landlord: Oh, come on! Don’t be a lazy little shit! You are young and don’t have back pains like I do. 
Ugh. He’s very persistent about it and I don’t want to end up on his bad side.
Maybe {f_botName} will like the change in the room. I could ask her about it after decorating.
You: Alright, I will take it.
Landlord: Alright!
Landlord: Be careful with them, they are an important item to me! And don’t you dare throw them out! I will end you if you do so!
You: Sure…
Landlord: I’m heading back, I’m frozen to the bone!
